name: io.github.mguttmann/the-real-bitwarden-mcp
title: Bitwarden Public API and Secrets Manager (unofficial)
description: Unofficial MCP server for the Bitwarden Public API and Secrets Manager, self-hosted or cloud.

environmentVariables.name: BITWARDEN_SELFHOST_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Self-hosted instance: API base URL, e.g. https://vault.example.com/api. Configure all four BITWARDEN_SELFHOST_* or all four BITWARDEN_CLOUD_* variables (or both); a partial set is fatal.

environmentVariables.name: BITWARDEN_SELFHOST_IDENTITY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Self-hosted instance: identity URL, e.g. https://vault.example.com/identity.

environmentVariables.name: BITWARDEN_SELFHOST_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Self-hosted instance: organization Public API client id (organization.<uuid>).

environmentVariables.name: BITWARDEN_SELFHOST_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Self-hosted instance: organization Public API client secret. It can manage members, groups, collections and policies, including creating Owners.

environmentVariables.name: BITWARDEN_CLOUD_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Bitwarden Cloud: API base URL, e.g. https://api.bitwarden.com. Used for license and subscription tools.

environmentVariables.name: BITWARDEN_CLOUD_IDENTITY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Bitwarden Cloud: identity URL, e.g. https://identity.bitwarden.com.

environmentVariables.name: BITWARDEN_CLOUD_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Bitwarden Cloud: organization Public API client id (organization.<uuid>).

environmentVariables.name: BITWARDEN_CLOUD_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Bitwarden Cloud: organization Public API client secret.

environmentVariables.name: BWS_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional: Secrets Manager machine account access token; enables the bws_* tools. A malformed token is fatal at startup.

environmentVariables.name: BWS_ORG_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional: organization UUID for the Secrets Manager tools, used when a call passes no organizationId.

environmentVariables.name: BWS_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: Secrets Manager API base URL; defaults to BITWARDEN_SELFHOST_API_BASE.

environmentVariables.name: BWS_IDENTITY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional: Secrets Manager identity URL; defaults to BITWARDEN_SELFHOST_IDENTITY_URL.

environmentVariables.name: BITWARDEN_CONFIRM_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: true: write tools return a preview unless the call carries confirm "YES". The model sets confirm itself, so this is friction, not a security boundary.

environmentVariables.name: BITWARDEN_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: true: write tools stay listed but refuse to run, and bw_raw_request allows GET only.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level of the JSON log lines on stderr.

environmentVariables.name: BW_MCP_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Successful tool output above this many bytes is cut to valid JSON with a responseTruncated marker that says how to narrow or page the query.
